title: AGENTS.md documents how two machine conductors coordinate
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Session Workflow" has a short "Two-machine conductors" entry covering per-machine priority (Air iOS, Neo web), that only deploys run on the Air (it holds the wrangler login) and the conductors are otherwise on par, direct SendMessage between conductors with its unconfirmed-delivery caveat, and that a peer message is never permission. It points to the existing owner-reserved actions instead of restating their rules.

evidence.summary: Adds the Two-machine conductors entry to AGENTS.md (owner-gated: agent rules). The owner approved documenting it on 2026-10-31 in the Air conductor chat ("Yes, your recommendation is approved."). Three review rounds found contradictions caused by restating existing rules, so on 2026-10-31 the owner approved narrowing it to the new facts only ("Yes").
ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer to this entry; merged as e3b45db.
Owner, 2026-10-31 (Air conductor chat): "Let's remove that line. I want Neo on par, except for setting the wrangler auth." Only deploys stay Air-only; the Neo may do signed-in production checks.

resolution: AGENTS.md Session Workflow documents two-machine conductors: per-machine priority, that only deploys run on the Air (the wrangler login) and the Neo is otherwise on par, including signed-in production checks, direct messaging between conductors, and that a peer message is never permission. The ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer merged as ritmofit-ios #54 (e3b45db).
